title: Reported GPGME vulnerability affects pre-2.3.0 apps; RCE framing disputed
summary: A reported vulnerability in GPGME, a library used by GnuPG-related and downstream applications, affects software built against versions before 2.3.0, according to a commenter who listed Gpg4win, GnuPG Desktop, most mail clients, many XMPP clients, Samba, and Flatpak. The same discussion disputes the “RCE” framing, with one commenter describing the flaw as a double-free bug rather than a proven remote-code-execution chain. A commenter said they were informed by GitLab on 2026-11-12 and disclosed the GPGME bug on 2026-11-20, earlier than a planned 2026-11-25 coordinated date because GitLab had to update for the Ruby2Shell bug. Upstream source content was not available, so the affected-version and severity details remain community-reported.
